use paddock_proc::ProcessId;

fn a(id: ProcessId) -> bool {
    id.is_alive() && id.presence() == Presence::Running
}

fn b(pid: i32) {
    unsafe { libc::kill(pid, libc::SIGTERM) };
    let me = sysinfo::Pid::from_u32(std::process::id());
    let you = Pid::from_u32(process::id());
}

pub fn is_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {
    false
}

fn c(app: &App) {
    let seen = presence(app);
    // paddock_proc::is_alive(pid) and kill(pid, 0)
    let s = "OpenProcess(x, 0, pid)";
}

fn d(pid: u32) -> bool {
    // conformance: pid-liveness — the pid came from a child handle this process owns
    paddock_proc::is_alive(pid)
}
